additional_info.subject: Troubleshooting by RC
additional_info.body:
Reported behavior/issue:
No SCB connection. Charger out of order.
Root cause:
Sim card not inserted error (even though sim card is actually inserted correctly)
For some reason APN Changed automatically to wrong. Third charger where the APN has changed by itself.
Solution:
APN changed manually back to the right one (cu.siemens.global)
Sim Card removed and put back in. Router rebooted.
Charger is working now.
Please report to QM or R&D for root cause analysis since this has happened now multiple times
